name: @spell-app/docs
description: Spell's docs:  hand-authored `.html` pages on @spell-app/ui, their templates and tooling, and plan docs

scripts.review:
yarn ts && yarn lint:fix && yarn format && yarn test && echo '== REVIEW PASSED
===========
'

echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> RUNNING TSC' && tsc -p tsconfig.json && echo '<< TSC PASSED
'
scripts.lint:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> LINTING WITH OXLINT' && vp lint --report-unused-disable-directives --max-warnings 0 tools && echo '<< OXLINT PASSED
'

echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> LINTING WITH OXLINT --fix' && vp lint --fix tools && echo '<< OXLINT PASSED
'
scripts.format:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> FORMATTING WITH OXFMT' && vp fmt . && echo '<< OXFMT PASSED
'
scripts.test:
echo '>>>>>>>>>>>
>> RUNNING TESTS' && vp test run --passWithNoTests && echo '<< TESTS PASSED
'
